svg.title: Gene 1.0 - 2S2P 18650 pack build: every cell, strip and lead connection
svg.text: Red = positive, black = negative, orange = BM midpoint. Grey bars are nickel strips. Pack-to-BMS onward is in wiring_power.svg.
Top view: pack in the tray, wrap off
Cells lie side by side, axes fore-aft. A, B point + forward; C, D point + rearward.
S1 · front strip · series link = BM
BM lead: along the top outer edge of cell A
Schematic: 2 in parallel, 2 groups in series
Volts measured from B−: nominal, then empty–full range.
Plug faces, looking into the pack side
Meter checks before plugging into the BMS

g.text: pin 2 → pin 3: 3.0–4.2 V (group 2), within 0.05 V of group 1
XT30 + to pin 3, XT30 − to pin 1: 0 V (same node)
Any other reading, or a minus sign: stop and find the fault.

svg.text: Close-up: attaching a wire to a strip (side view, rear end of the pack)
Wires are soldered, never welded. The joint goes on a tab of strip that sticks out past the cells, never on strip sitting on a cell.

g.text: Tin the tab and the wire, then join
them in 2–3 s. 60 W+ iron, flux.
The tab sticks up past the top
of the pack. The wall stops lower.
Fold the tab onto the top, joint in a
valley. Tape the wire 10 mm on.
No iron on strip that sits on a cell,
or on the cell. No welding copper
Why fold over the top: the tray walls touch the ends and sides of the pack, so a joint can't sit there. The walls stop at cell-centre height, and above them
there's room under the deck in the valleys between cells and on cell A's outer shoulder. Use one tab per wire, or put a main and a balance wire on the same tab.
1. Use 4 cells of the same model and batch. Bring each to within 0.05 V of the others before joining anything (they end up in parallel).
2. Put an insulator ring (fish paper) on every + end: A and B at the front, C and D at the rear. Glue or tape the cells side by side as shown.
3. Spot-weld S2 and S3 first, keeping the gap between them. Weld S1 last: it closes the circuit and makes 7.2 V live on the strips.
4. Never solder onto a cell. Solder each wire to a strip tab on the bench, weld the strip, then fold the tab over the top on kapton (close-up above).
5. Run the BM lead along the top outer edge of cell A, under the deck. Bring all 5 leads out at the rear (about 300 mm long).
6. Wrap the pack (end caps, then heat-shrink). It must fit 74.4 × 65 × 18.5 mm plus wrap. Then do the meter checks above.
7. Plug in the XT30 first, then the balance plug; unplug in reverse. If the BMS output reads 0 V, connect the charger briefly to wake it.
Bought a pre-built 2S2P pack with a balance lead? Skip to the meter checks to confirm its pinout, then step 7.
